storage.temporary_storage: 512 MiB tmpfs, charged to container memory
storage.limits: This profile opens both engines in memory and mounts the same uncompressed CSV read-only. Host st_blocks*512 is allocated input storage, not native engine size or Docker VM disk use. No persisted-engine compression comparison or cold-storage claim.

cases.cpu_utilization_scope: Cgroup CPU includes runtime, wrapper and accounting commands; denominator is Docker StartedAt to FinishedAt, parsed at microsecond resolution. CPU snapshot precedes the final accounting commands/exit, so their final CPU is not included. Driver uptime window has 10 ms resolution; per-query CPU and wall time are separate exact-clock samples.

block_io.scope: Whole-container kernel block-I/O accounting, including wrapper. Empty counters/cached reads do not establish zero physical host I/O; Docker Desktop file sharing can perform work outside this cgroup. Not logical engine bytes, device latency or queue depth.

sampled_resources.scope: Approximately 100 ms plus API/inspection overhead; arithmetic sample mean, not heap or time-weighted mean. Sampling can miss short peaks; use native cgroup memory.peak and process RSS too. Docker daemon/VM overhead excluded.

block_io.scope: Whole-container kernel block-I/O accounting, including wrapper. Empty counters/cached reads do not establish zero physical host I/O; Docker Desktop file sharing can perform work outside this cgroup. Not logical engine bytes, device latency or queue depth.

sampled_resources.scope: Approximately 100 ms plus API/inspection overhead; arithmetic sample mean, not heap or time-weighted mean. Sampling can miss short peaks; use native cgroup memory.peak and process RSS too. Docker daemon/VM overhead excluded.

controller.scope: Host controller includes retained-fixture hashing, native API sampling and report generation. CLI subprocess CPU excludes server-side work. Docker daemon/VM excluded; this is separate from engine container costs.

scope: Same native engines and C ABI in Python, C++ and Rust; two million seeded trades and ten thousand customers. Three fresh processes per cell; warm 15-query samples, not sustained capacity, OS-cold storage, persistence or native-language implementation comparisons.
limits: Cgroup I/O can omit host-side Docker file sharing. Sample means/peaks can miss fast transitions; native cgroup/RSS peaks are separate. Native storage compression is not applicable: both engines are in memory and /tmp is tmpfs. Host controller CPU and peak RSS are separate; controller average RSS/time series and Docker daemon/VM costs are not collected.
